occurrences.text: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.
And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.
No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.
Whom I have sent again: thou therefore receive him, that is, mine own bowels:

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
